title: SpaceX Shares Fall 6.37% to $134.72 in Oct. 30 Trading
text:
SpaceX Shares Fall 6.37% to $134.72 in Oct. 30 Trading | TokenPost 
 Advertisement Sunday, November 1, 2026 Sections Sign in News Markets Feed Data Research Home Investing 1 min read Add as a preferred source on Google SpaceX Shares Fall 6.37% to $134.72 in Oct. 30 Trading
 SPCX lost $9.17 and finished the session at 4 p.m. ET (20:00 UTC).
 By Enna Lee Published Oct 31, 2026, 3:51 PM EDT Save Share A blank share certificate rests across a descending red steel wedge / TokenPost.ai SpaceX’s Nasdaq-listed Class A shares fell 6.37% Friday, Oct. 30, closing at $134.72 after a $9.17 decline during the U.S. trading session.
 SPCX ended at $134.72 at 4 p.m. ET (20:00 UTC), down $9.17 from the previous close.
 SpaceX’s Class A shares trade on Nasdaq under the ticker SPCX.
 The 6.37% decrease and $9.17 loss refer to the Oct. 30 session, which ended at 4 p.m. ET.
